analysis_notes.text_character: Torah #115 (LM2) is a pure narrative account (sipur) with no bechina language and no conceptual equations. The Rebbe describes his personal practice: he would choose a straight path in divine service, follow it steadfastly for a period while rejecting all distracting thoughts, and only after a lengthy time had passed would he reconsider and choose a new order if needed. The text uses no formulation of 'X הוא בחינת Y' anywhere. There are therefore no missing bechina nodes to flag, and no gap analysis is possible or needed.
